lang.name: English
tagline: Share a password or a secret with a link that works only once.
theme.toggle: Switch between light and dark mode
home.title: Share a secret
home.secretPlaceholder: Password, key or message. It is encrypted in your browser before it is sent.
home.passphraseHint: The recipient needs it as well. Send it on another channel.
created.title: Your secret link is ready
created.share: Send this link to the recipient:
created.receipt: Keep this link to check the status or burn the secret:
reveal.title: You received a secret
reveal.intro: Someone sent you a secret. It can be shown {n} more time(s), then it is deleted.
reveal.done: This is the secret. Copy it now: this page cannot show it again.
reveal.doneLeft: This is the secret. It can be shown {n} more time(s).
reveal.burnedByAttempts: Too many wrong passphrases: the secret was destroyed.
reveal.nokey: The link is incomplete: the part after # is missing. Ask the sender for the full link.
reveal.badkey: The secret could not be decrypted. The link may be damaged.
gone.title: This secret is gone
gone.text: It was already viewed, burned or it expired. Ask the sender for a new one if you still need it.
receipt.title: Secret status
receipt.burnConfirm: Delete the secret now? Nobody can view it afterwards.
receipt.notfound: No status for this link. It is unknown or too old.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.ratelimit: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
error.nojs: Vanishly encrypts in your browser and needs JavaScript.
error.tooShort: The secret must be at least {n} characters long.
error.passTooShort: The passphrase must be at least {n} characters long.
error.passRequired: Enter a passphrase: this server requires one.
error.passRequiredNoRecipients: Enter a passphrase or choose a recipient: without recipients this server requires a passphrase.
home.confirm: I confirm that this secret contains only one password: not several passwords, no user name and no links that together give access to a whole system.
nav.label: Main menu
reveal.introOnce: Someone sent you a secret. It can be shown only once, then it is deleted.
auth.title: Sign in to share a secret
auth.createText: On this server only signed-in users can create secret links.
auth.failed: The sign-in did not work. Try again.
auth.unavailable: The sign-in service is not reachable right now. Try again later.
home.groupSearchHint: Type at least 2 letters of the group name.
home.peopleHint: Type at least 2 letters of a name, then pick a person. A full e-mail address also works.
home.peopleCount: {n} suggestions, choose with the arrow keys.
home.recipientsHint: Recipients must sign in before they can see the secret. With nobody listed, anyone with the link can open it.
error.recipientInvalid: {name} is not a valid e-mail address.
error.loginRequired: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
created.restricted: Only the chosen people can open it, after signing in.
reveal.lockedLogin: This secret is only for certain people. Sign in to show it.
reveal.lockedDenied: This secret was not shared with your account ({name}).
reveal.notRecipient: This secret was not shared with your account.
reveal.introRestricted: Someone sent you a secret that only certain people can open.
home.responsibleHint: Who looks after this secret: may see its status (who opened it, when) and burn it.
error.responsibleRequired: Name at least one responsible person or group: who may see the status and burn the secret.
receipt.loginText: Sign in to see the status of this secret.
receipt.notAllowed: This status is only for the creator, the responsible people and who opened the secret.
receipt.creator: Created by
receipt.burnNotAllowed: Only the creator and the responsible people may burn it.
home.commentHint: What it is for, e.g. a ticket number. Not part of the secret: admins see it in the audit log, you on the status page.
error.commentRequired: Please write a comment: what is the secret for?
tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: Personal tokens for scripts and tools. A token acts as you: everything done with it is in the audit log with your name and the token's name.
tokens.loginText: Sign in to manage your API tokens.
tokens.notAllowed: Your account may not create API tokens. Ask an admin to enable it.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.nameHint: What uses it, e.g. api_aap or the name of a script.
tokens.ipsHint: One IP address or network per line, e.g. 203.0.113.10 or 2001:db8::/48. From anywhere else the token is refused. Your address: {ip}
tokens.created: Your new token. Copy it now: it is shown only this once.
tokens.commentRequired: This server requires a comment on every API call: header X-Audit-Comment.
tokens.col.name: Name
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke the token "{name}"? Scripts using it stop working at once.
tokens.errorName: Please give the token a name.
tokens.errorIps: Please name at least one address or network.
tokens.error: The token could not be created: {message}
admin.title: Audit log
admin.intro: Who did what, when, for whom. Every look at this page is logged too.
admin.loginText: Sign in as an admin to see the audit log.
admin.notAllowed: This page is only for admins.
admin.verifyOk: Hash chain intact: {n} events, nothing changed, removed or moved.
admin.verifyBad: Hash chain broken: {n} problem(s), first at line {line}: {problem}
